details:
Description

after the recent patch, while looking diagonally feels better, looking around in general feels choppy and laggy. The actual framerate doesnt seem to go down at all, it just feels very choppy and seeming to feel around 30fps or so maybe less. Holding shift (sprint) seems to fix it for whatever reason and walking while not looking seems smooth still too, so its only moving that causes the issues. I've tried multiple avatars, from my custom horribly optimized ones and some really well optimized ones I've favorited it all seems the same.

Reproduction Steps

It's always active (unless I hold shift), happens with vsync off or on, and with uncapped or capped framerate.

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Always
